name: Ecco Verde
description: Online shop for organic and natural cosmetics covering face, make-up, body, hair, men and baby care. Its German-language shipping page lists Germany with free standard shipping above 42.90 EUR, plus many other countries.
description_es: Tienda online de cosmética orgánica y natural para rostro, maquillaje, cuerpo, cabello, hombre y bebé. Su página de envíos en alemán incluye Alemania con envío estándar gratis desde 42,90 EUR y muchos otros países.

ships_to.notes: Standard shipping is free from 42.90 EUR, otherwise 5.29 EUR. Express options depend on weight. No regional limits stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: No store pickup. Delivery to a DHL Packstation is offered.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Some products carry extra handling fees shown on the product page. Product pages in German.
